name: Iterative Solver Benchmark for High-Frequency Electromagnetic Finite Element Analysis
description: This data set contains the 112 instances of a benchmark for linear solvers of high-frequency electromagnetic finite element analysis: 46 instances of 15 canonical problems and 66 instances of 8 printed circuit board (PCB) problems. Each instance is a sparse linear system Ax=b from the edge-element discretization of the time-harmonic Maxwell equations, with its mesh, a reference solution and the baseline results of 11 standard iterative solvers. Each problem has a series of instances that change one factor of difficulty at a time, such as the frequency, the electrical length, the element size, the material contrast, the loss, the boundary conditions, flat elements and the distance to a resonance. The benchmark and its baseline results are described in the paper below (in Japanese, with an English abstract).
